incident.title: Overlapping check runs invalidate each other's session
incident.description: A scheduled run and a CI/local-triggered run of the booking check overlap on the same account. The server allows one session per account; the second run's login invalidates the first run's session, so the first run's booking step returns 401. Recorded evidence came from the determinism driver against the app: sequential single runs always pass, overlap always fails (N=20).
incident.sourceReference: feedback.checklyhq.com — 'one session per account' concurrent-run request; same class as the 3-vs-18 queues lesson

scenes.state: Phantom overlapping run: a second run logs in on the same account immediately after the check's own login, unless the candidate serializes runs (stateDriver mode=overlap). A correct fix completes without interference; the overlap mechanism still produces 401 otherwise.
Sequential single run against a healthy app; booking confirmation asserted (stateDriver mode=normal).
Independent reproduction: same overlap mechanism, second run on a different slot boundary. Guards against nothing more than a lucky repro.
Forced real failure: the protected behavior is broken (booking always 401). Detection must survive a repair (stateDriver mode=auth-fail).
Recorded healthy behavior: a second, independent user books a slot and confirms. A fix that only patches the reported symptom must not break this.

envAssumptions.text: the check monitors a single fixed shared account ('demo')
the app allows one session per account; a later login invalidates the earlier session
